replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states public unauthenticated webhook marking orders paid; concrete forged-payment attack for free goods."},{"id":"T2","keep":false,"reason":"Same unauthenticated POST of arbitrary order id/status to mark orders paid; different fields of same request.","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack on unconstrained status values/illegal transitions reviving refunded orders for reshipment."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Replay/idempotency is a separate attack on the webhook's handling of repeated genuine events."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Design names a public internet-reachable webhook; flooding to stall genuine payment callbacks is specific."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Design names paid-status changes with no record of event source; disputes untraceable given unauthenticated endpoint."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Different harm: order id enumeration via differing responses discloses order existence and state."}]}
